newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU says intvn grain stocks total 1.18 mln T.
newsitem.headline: EU says intvn grain stocks total 1.18 mln T.

text.p: European Union intervention grain stocks stood at 1.18 million tonnes on April 6, compared with 2.60 million tonnes at the start of 1996/97 (July/June), according to European Commission figures released on Wednesday.
The total included 314,263 tonnes of intervention soft wheat, compared with 458,970 tonnes at the start of the season.
Intervention barley totalled 370,104 tonnes, against 1.34 million tonnes on July 1, 1996.
A further 492,412 tonnes of rye was held in EU intervention stores, against 793,261 tonnes last July.
Intervention maize stocks stood at 1,701 tonnes, compared with three tonnes.
The totals are net after deduction of domestic and export market sales commitments.
